end session NAME-SUFFIX and its tmux server: claude exits as when its terminal
closes, and what claude started through tmux ends too. claude runs its
SessionEnd hooks with the reason "other", and may still run them when cld kill
returns.

Usage:
  cld kill [-n NAME] -s SUFFIX [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for kill
  -n, --name NAME       the session's NAME, before -SUFFIX: by default the
                        git repository's name here, or else the directory's
  -s, --suffix SUFFIX   the session's SUFFIX, after NAME-
